hook: Let's rank the craziest football red cards!

items.line: Neymar rolling on the floor for ten minutes? Give him an Oscar, D-Tier!
Pepe kicking everyone like a ninja? Psycho behavior, C-Tier.
Luis Suarez biting a player? Disgusting, B-Tier.
But Zidane headbutting Materazzi in the World Cup Final? Absolutely iconic S-Tier madness!
